pa_server.label: PulseAudio server address
pa_server.description: PulseAudio server socket or TCP address. Leave empty to auto-detect from the PULSE_SERVER environment variable or the default socket path (e.g. /run/audio/pulse.sock on HAOS).

include_monitors.label: Include monitor sources
include_monitors.description: When enabled, sink monitor sources (loopbacks of audio outputs) also appear in the source selection list and browse view.

source_name.label: Source
source_name.description: The PulseAudio source to expose. Leave empty to expose all discovered sources. Set to a specific source to use this instance for one source only — add the provider again for each additional source that needs independent settings.
